text.en: Dog owners report that pets feel remarkably calm and contented during grooming appointments, even when arriving nervous. Clients with elderly crossbreeds and anxious dogs note that the gentle handling helps pets relax, leaving them settled throughout their pamper session.

Pet owners are pleased with the quality of dog grooming, reporting that pets return home looking immaculate, neat, and ready for festive occasions. Several reviewers remark that coats look beautifully maintained, making it their preferred local salon for routine tidy-ups.

Grooming clients speak warmly of groomer Katie and her friendly customer care, noting effortless bookings and five-star pampering for their pets. In contrast, a garden centre shopper reported an abrupt and unhelpful interaction with retail staff when inquiring about bedding plants.

q.en: Is dog grooming offered alongside the garden centre?

a.en: Yes, Pets & Gardens features an on-site dog grooming salon led by groomer Katie alongside garden supplies.

q.en: How does the groomer handle older or anxious dogs?

a.en: Clients note that nervous and elderly dogs are handled very gently, returning home happy and thoroughly relaxed.

q.en: Is booking a dog grooming appointment straightforward?

a.en: Reviewers mention that scheduling a grooming session is super easy and supported by welcoming customer service.

q.en: Does Pets & Gardens stock seasonal plants and bulbs?

a.en: Yes, regular customers praise the quality of seasonal garden plants, bedding flowers, and spring daffodils.
